messages.subject: DSsim, mads release
parts:
Dear all,

Please note that new versions of DSism and mads are available on CRAN.
These versions are the ones released in Distance 7 alpha.

DSsim has improved plotting functions for density and region objects. Please note that I have switched the default colours in the density plotting function, red - low, white - high. Contours now display the density values.

mads has only minor updates.

Thanks,

Laura
 
Dr. L. Marshall
Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St. Andrews
